_comment: Scoped per-commit mutation gate (coding-standards §12.1/§12.5): mutate ONLY the load-bearing logic THIS change touched — the pure seams issue #36 added — not pre-existing code or DOM writers. Ranges: workflow_graph_lod.js wfgEdgeCoverage (moved out of workflow_graph.js by the issue #41 split, behaviour-preserving), coverage_model.js verdict logic, coverage_indicator.js gatherSources + fmtAge. The prior seams (renderer computeNeighborSet/linkTier, filters buildPredicate, wfgLodTier) were unchanged here; their mutation state is recorded in tests/js/MUTATION_NOTES.md from issue #35.
_comment_vitest: related:false — source: stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/troubleshooting #vitest-failed-to-find-test-files-related-to-mutated-files. The suites load the browser IIFEs into a shared jsdom global instead of importing them, so Stryker 9's related-file tracing finds no tests.
